caption: The drawing features a single ceramic jug centered on a plain, off-white background. The jug is beige with a slightly darker brown rim and interior. It has a single handle on the right side. The body of the jug is decorated with a blue floral or leaf pattern on the front-left lower portion. The word "CLARKE" and "POTTERY" in uppercase letters are faintly visible near the jug's upper section, just below the rim. The artist's signature, "Jessie M Young 93," appears in small text in the bottom left corner of the drawing. There are no other objects or details present; the scene is minimalistic with the focus solely on the jug.
title: Water Pitcher
